replication_unit: technical repeated HTTP transactions between the same hosts with fixed synthetic bodies
measurement: synthetic transport-only HTTP transaction completion, application body bytes only

notes.request_ms: Dispatch through complete response body using client perf_counter only.
notes.request_upload_write_ms: Writing headers/body to socket; includes local buffer and TCP backpressure, not one-way upload latency.
notes.response_download_ms: Body-read time after response headers; includes buffered bytes; not isolated physical transfer time.
notes.goodput: Successful chosen-direction application body bits / measured batch elapsed. Includes HTTP turnaround, host copies, failures and client validation time. Echo aggregate counts both directions. Not iperf bandwidth.
notes.data: Fixed synthetic x bytes, not model-generated z or LBC1 serialization.
notes.warmup: Excluded independently for every endpoint and size; connections reuse by default.
